Research Mode

Research Mode turns PhysicaX into a reproducible sandbox for parameter sweeps, batch runs, and publishable outputs. It is built on the same formula registry but adds workflow and compute tooling.

Core Features

Parameter Sweeps

Batch runs across one or two parameters with structured outputs.

Async Jobs

Queue heavy simulations on workers and return stable run ids.

Notebook Mode

Combine text, equations, plots, and experiment snapshots.

Exports

CSV, JSON, PDF, and reproducibility metadata.
